title: Crypto-Wednesdays Show - Videos
description: Every Wednesday 8.30am Eastern Standard Time, 2.30pm Central European Time, 8.30pm Singapore Time, hosts Gordon Einstein & Sander de Bruijn are inviting blockchain and crypto friends as guest speakers to share the newest market insights, developments, innovations and much more. Join us weekly and invite your friends to listen along also. Our mission is to contribute to the industry and share with friends.
